rules.name: RecoveryStateMismatch
rules.query:
andara_recovery_state_hash_match == 0
or
(
  max by (environment, namespace) (
      kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_exitcode{container="server", pod=~"andara-[0-9]+"} == 8
    or
      kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_exitcode{container="server", pod=~"andara-[0-9]+"} == 6
  )
  and on (environment, namespace)
  max by (environment, namespace) (
    kube_pod_container_status_ready{container="server", pod=~"andara-[0-9]+"} == 0
  )
)

annotations.summary: A recovery did not reproduce the recorded World state — the server refused to take traffic
